datasets.name: linkedin_kpis
queryLines: SELECT total_connections, distinct_companies, total_messages, conversations, outgoing_invitations, incoming_invitations, connections_since_2024, top_company, top_company_connections, first_connection, latest_connection

datasets.name: linkedin_top_companies
queryLines:
SELECT company, connections, share_pct
FROM personal.gold.connections_by_company
ORDER BY connections DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: linkedin_top_positions
queryLines:
SELECT position, connections, share_pct
FROM personal.gold.connections_by_position
ORDER BY connections DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: linkedin_career
queryLines:
SELECT company_name, title, location, started_on, finished_on, is_current
FROM personal.gold.career_timeline
ORDER BY started_on

datasets.name: linkedin_engagement_type
queryLines:
SELECT event_type, subtype, events, share_pct
FROM personal.gold.engagement_by_type
ORDER BY events DESC

datasets.name: linkedin_endorsement_skills
queryLines:
SELECT skill_name, endorsements, distinct_endorsers, share_pct
FROM personal.gold.endorsements_by_skill
ORDER BY endorsements DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: linkedin_endorsement_kpis
queryLines: SELECT received_total, given_total, accepted, rejected, top_skill, top_skill_endorsements

datasets.name: linkedin_saved_jobs
queryLines:
SELECT company_name, jobs_saved, latest_saved, share_pct
FROM personal.gold.saved_jobs_by_company
ORDER BY jobs_saved DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: linkedin_search_terms
queryLines:
SELECT search_term, searches, first_searched, last_searched
FROM personal.gold.search_terms
ORDER BY searches DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: linkedin_profile
queryLines: SELECT headline, industry, geo_location, member_since, positions, skills, languages, projects, publications, events, certifications, education, members_followed

datasets.name: linkedin_inferences
queryLines:
SELECT category, inference_type, inference, description
FROM personal.silver.inferences_cleaned
ORDER BY category, inference_type

datasets.name: linkedin_security
queryLines:
SELECT challenge_type, challenges, first_seen, last_seen, countries
FROM personal.gold.security_challenges_summary
ORDER BY challenges DESC

datasets.name: linkedin_recommendations
queryLines: SELECT given_total, given_visible, last_given, received_total, received_visible, last_received
